name: H5. Visit-type utilization by month
rawText:
# Do you know when your healthcare facilities are busiest and how many appointments are being missed?
#  - Which months experience the highest patient visit volumes?
#  - Which types of visits account for the largest share of healthcare activity?
#  - Are no-show rates increasing during particular months or for specific visit types?
#  - What percentage of scheduled visits are missed, and where is the problem most significant?
#  - How much time do physicians spend with patients on average across different visit types?
#  - Which visit types generate the highest total charges?
#  - Are certain months experiencing high appointment volumes but also unusually high no-show rates?
#  - How can we identify seasonal demand patterns to improve staffing and appointment scheduling?
#  - Are there opportunities to reduce missed appointments and improve healthcare resource utilization?
# __________________________________________________

VisitUtilizationByMonth is Visits:
    VisitDate.Year() VisitYear,
    VisitDate.Month() VisitMonth,
    VisitType,
    Count(Id) ScheduledVisits,
    CountIf(Status = <No-Show>) NoShows,
    (CountIf(Status = <No-Show>) * 100.0 / Count(Id)).Round(2) NoShowPercent,
    AvgIf(DurationMinutes, Status = <Completed>).Round(1) AverageMinutes,
    Sum(Charge).Round(2) Charges
  Order ScheduledVisits DESC
  Take 10
